environment.cpu: ARMv8 (64-bit) Family 8 Model 2 Revision 201, Qualcomm Technologies Inc

method.payloadGenerator: xorshift32 seed0x731997, shifts13/17/5, low byte per step; deterministic replacements enforce FF distributions.
method.order: Balanced ABBA/BAAB; A=original, B=optimized; alternating by comparison index and block.
method.timing: Fixed work counts; parity and snapshots before/after each timed leg; no hashing or output copying inside direct-kernel timing.
method.allocation: Total allocated bytes and GC collections per timed leg; no forced collections; retained capacity and peak memory are not inferred.
method.shuffleTable: One lazy immutable 256x16-byte vector array:4096 payload bytes plus managed header; initialized before timing; no per-call table allocation.
method.scope: Four word distributions, two token replay workloads and eight complete JPEG controls; no native or full-corpus verdict. Automatic policy is unchanged.
